title: Promise
description: A narrative promise opened in one scene and resolved in another. Promise Ledger entries are append-only. No GO at chapter level if any overdue promises exist. See also promise_ledger.schema.json for the event log.

type.description: Promise category. series_thread promises span books; tracked in series_promise_ledger.

opened_in_scene.description: Scene ID where this promise was established.

opened_by.description: Agent ID that created this promise (e.g. outliner, writer_agent).

target_resolution_scene.description: Scene ID where this promise is planned to resolve. Null if unscheduled.

must_resolve_by.description: Latest scene ID by which this promise must be resolved. Convergence Controller blocks GO if overdue.

status.description: Current status. 'broken' is a hard fail logged to the issue report.

resolved_in_scene.description: Scene ID where this promise was resolved. Null while status != resolved.

priority.description: Narrative importance. 5 = central arc promise; 1 = minor texture detail.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the promise (e.g. 'The locked box in Chapter 2 must be opened before the climax').

acceptable_resolutions.description: Short descriptions of acceptable resolution forms. Used by Convergence Controller to evaluate candidate resolutions.
